name: Planet Party Time
description:
About This Game

"Planet Party Time" is a social simulation game that's all about growth, and perfect for any kind of player. It combines the therapeutic elements of social simulation games with the creative fun of party games so that all players can find their niche.

Characters have almost unlimited potential for customization, and their over 100,000 strands of hair are rendered in high quality. Collect hats, clothes, glasses, and shoes from across the galaxy to express your style, and use various furniture to decorate your room.

Life in space isn't easy, but your versatile robot PADI will help you, transforming into a skateboard, car, harvester, boat, aircraft, fishing rod, food stall, camera, and even a device that can read minds... You can enhance your natural abilities with high-tech equipment: overcome planetary gravity with Bounce Shoes, fly higher with a Jetpack, attack with projectiles while driving a battle vehicle—you are a continuously growing cosmic Hero Candidate!

Each player's initial planet is different, but through your efforts, you can beautify the environment, till the land to plant various crops; fish in wild waters or operate fisheries, capture various strange insects; mine for ores and relics, and donate them to museums or crafting with them; drive various vehicles and aircraft to automate your planet; build recreational and sports facilities to make residents happier. You'll create your own unique and wonderful planet while exploring the secrets of the Cube Core below and the starry sky above!

Your planet will gradually welcome over 40 residents from across the galaxy, each with different backgrounds and unique stories. As the community leader, you'll build homes for them and regularly interact and chat with them. They'll gradually become your close partners, opening various shops on your planet, receiving visitors from across the galaxy, helping the planet earn more income, and accelerating its improvement alongside you. Don't forget, they each have different schedules—learn their stories, seek their help, fulfill their wishes, and earn their smiles. The more you participate in the activities, the more you can learn about the galaxy's secrets!

There are many Hero Candidates like you in the galaxy. The Cube Galaxy Union publishes a daily schedule featuring over 120 multiplayer party minigames, with a minigame running once every 20 minutes. Whenever you're free, you can sign up individually or as a team. In a Star Party, 32 heroes will gather together to participate in 4 random minigames, while Escapade Tour uses a three-round elimination system for a single minigame, and Hero Parties will determine the Wild Cards for the galaxy's illustrious Lucky Hero Tour. Whether as teammates or opponents, friends who party together will appear in your social circle! If you want to accelerate your planet's development, participating in parties and Esports events is the right choice—there are generous rewards!

Hero Candidates need a strong base from which to explore the star regions at the edge of the Light and Dark Galaxies. Exploring these remote regions requires you to build more powerful rockets and team up with friends to continuously track secrets and find stories hidden in the stars, collecting treasures from across the galaxy, and ultimately defeating the forces of evil.

The game provides a simple but powerful level editor. You can create your own minigames, from racing, platforming, and puzzles to side-scrolling, cooperative, and competitive games. You can not only invite your in-game friends to experience them but also publish them online for players all across the world to enjoy. You can even host Esports competitions for players from all across the globe to join.

Each season, we will introduce unique content, including adding new aspects to life on the Cube Planet, more party minigames, and more cosmic exploration stories. We look forward to connecting planets of the Cube Galaxy more closely together!
short_desc: "Planet Party Time" combines social sim & party games. As an alien, team with robot PADI to restore a planet via unique recruits. Become a Cube Galaxy Hero Candidate: explore space, play minigames for rewards. Build custom minigames via intuitive editor & host parties!
